醒.meaning: A falling <part>star</part> lands on a stick of <part>dynamite</part> beside a snoring night guard. BOOM: it was packed with confetti, and the guard sits bolt upright, eyes like saucers. He has never been so <kanji>awake</kanji>.
醒.on: He checks the steel <sound>sa</sound>fe he was meant to be guarding: still locked.
醒.kun: His neighbour runs over in her <sound>sa</sound>ri to shake the rest of the confetti off him.

喝.meaning: A lifeguard sits under a <part>sunshade</part> all day, shouting from her <part>mouth</part> at swimmers: 'Too far! Come back! No running!' By sunset, all that comes out is a tiny croak, and a seagull has to shout for her. Her voice is <kanji>hoarse</kanji>.
喝.on: A swimmer brings her a hot <sound>katsu</sound> sandwich, and she can only croak her thanks.

岬.meaning: A <part>mountain</part> wades out into the sea wearing a shell of <part>armor</part> on its nose, to take the hits from the waves. The fishing town shelters behind it. Sailors call that rocky point a <kanji>headland</kanji>.
岬.on: On its tip stands a lighthouse shaped like an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne.
岬.kun: '<sound>Me</sound>!' barks a seal, claiming the tip, and lines up its <sound>sar</sound>dines next to a stolen <sound>ki</sound>wi.

彙.meaning: A fussy hedgehog presses his <part>blanket</part> flat with a tiny <part>iron</part>, then tips out a basket of <part>fruit</part> and sorts it: apples in one row, plums in another, never mixed. Every row holds things of the <kanji>same kind</kanji>.
彙.on: A visiting <sound>ee</sound>l tries to wriggle into the plum row and is gently sent back.
彙.kun: At bedtime the hedgehog sighs '<sound>Ha</sound>,' fluffs up his <sound>ree</sound>d <sound>ne</sound>st, rests his head on a <sound>zu</sound>cchini and murmurs, 'Just <sound>me</sound>.'

綻.meaning: A tailor is <part>determine</part>d to fit a giant into a suit sewn with ordinary <part>thread</part>. The giant takes one deep breath, and every seam pops at once until the jacket hangs in rags. Cloth pulled that tight is bound to <kanji>be rent</kanji>.
綻.on: His shirt tail flaps like a windsock as he stomps off into a <sound>tun</sound>nel.
綻.kun: On the far side the giant just smiles and naps in the <sound>ho</sound>t sun, on a camp <sound>co</sound>t propped on a <sound>ro</sound>ck.

拷.meaning: A pirate captain drops <part>anchor</part> in a dead-calm sea and makes his crew <part>consider</part> his poetry: all nine hundred verses, read aloud very slowly. Nobody may leave the deck until the end. For the crew, it's sheer <kanji>torture</kanji>.
拷.on: Even the ship's <sound>goa</sound>t covers its ears with its hooves.

弄.meaning: A bored <part>king</part> sets up a <part>goal</part> in the palace garden and spends the afternoon kicking his crown into it, juggling his sceptre and twirling his robe tassels. Ruling can wait: he'd rather <kanji>play with</kanji> things.
弄.on: His goalkeeper is a red <sound>ro</sound>se in a flowerpot.
弄.kun: '<sound>Ee</sound>k!' cries the queen, as he twiddles every knob on the royal <sound>jee</sound>p.
